question.text: The Investor Charter for Research Analysts includes:

answer.text: Services provided, investor rights and responsibilities, do's and don'ts, grievance handling mechanism and estimated timelines
Only rights related to equity investments

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 291 of the NISM XV workbook describes the Investor Charter for Research Analysts as covering services, investor rights, do's and don'ts, responsibilities, grievance handling mechanism and estimated timelines. The full RA Investor Charter and complaint/SCORES route are reproduced on pages 328-330. The Trap: The RA Investor Charter is specific to research analyst services. It does not, on the pages checked, claim coverage across all market segments or apply to any SEBI-registered intermediary. Note: Source-backed by NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026), pages 291-292 and 328-330.
